document: Fayda (national digital ID), with a physical card on request
office: the National ID Program (Fayda), at registration centres

routes.label: registration in person at a Fayda centre; the 12-digit number by SMS, a printed card on request

note: The National ID Program's services page: any resident registers in person with biometrics and documents and receives a 12-digit Fayda Identification Number by SMS; a digital copy, or a physical card if requested, follows. Its fee, term and time aren't stated (Kana TV reports the card costs 350 birr to produce, a cost, not a fee). Before Fayda the de facto identity document was the local kebele card (Landinfo, 2020), not modelled.

sources.title: National ID Program (Ethiopia), Services
sources.said: Fayda is designed to provide all residents of Ethiopia with a secure digital ID with full unique identifier ... Once registered, you'll recieve your unique 12-digit Fayda Identification Number (FIN) via SMS to your mobile. If preferred, It can also be offered in Digital copy via our telebirr mini app or solid physical ID card if requested by the resident.
